title: The 3D Website Builder WordPress plugin through 2.0.3 does not perform any authorisation check in one of its publicly…
description: The 3D Website Builder WordPress plugin up to version 2.0.3 contains a vulnerability where one of its publicly accessible AJAX actions lacks proper authorization checks. The nonce intended to protect this action is exposed to any visitor on pages embedding the plugin's shortcode. This allows unauthenticated users to permanently delete 3D builder objects and their slides.
